thread:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert fired: HIGH - vpc-egress-route-flap for customer AcmeCorp (private deployment us-west-2)
Alex Chen: seeing PD page, routing through this thread. anyone oncall for private/vpc? /cc @Priya
Priya Patel: I am oncall for private networking this shift, looking now. what symptoms does PD show?
Incident Bot: Alert details: 5xx spikes on customer control plane connectivity checks, agent heartbeats drop to 0 for 7m, BGP session flaps observed between customer VGW and our transit. Alert ID: PD-83421
Alex Chen: logs: ```
kubectl -n private-controlplane logs controlplane-5 -f | tail -n 200
... WARN failed to reach agent AcmeCorp-agent-1: i/o timeout
``` 
Jordan Lee: I see similar for two other customers in same AZ but only AcmeCorp hitting service degradation SLA. link to PD incident: https://pagerduty.example/incident/PD-83421
Priya Patel: pinging network team, checking route table changes. @Maya can you confirm if customer reported any errors? risk: partial traffic egress failures causing inference requests to timeout (client visible)
Maya (Customer Support): AcmeCorp sent a ticket ~2m ago: "our private inference is failing with timeout errors, intermittent, started ~12:42 PDT" they've got synthetic traffic failing to reach model endpoints
Alex Chen: ok impact confirmed. plan: 1) validate BGP status 2) if routes flapping, trigger route refresh / withdraw/advertise 3) if control plane unreachable, failover to redundant control plane node 4) keep customer updated
Priya Patel: running bgp status from our vpc-router:
```
vty# show bgp summary | include AcmeCorp
Neighbor 10.12.8.1  Establ. 00:00:13  State: Idle (flapping)
Prefixes: 128/0
``` 
Priya Patel: yep flapping every ~15s, looks like customer gateway is bouncing or ISP path unstable
Jordan Lee: can we temporarily advertise a static route through fallback egress to avoid blackholing customer traffic? what's config impact for other tenants?
Alex Chen: fallback path exists in us-west-2-aux, low capacity but should handle small synthetic and control-plane traffic. I'll open the play to shift AcmeCorp to aux-egress with a route-map change.
Priya Patel: before we change, we should attempt a soft-reconfig: `clear bgp neighbor 10.12.8.1 soft` to avoid complete flap. doing it now.
Incident Bot: Action logged: clear bgp neighbor 10.12.8.1 soft (exec by Priya Patel)
Priya Patel: soft clear didn't stick, neighbor re-enters idle within 20s. preparing route advertisement change. Alex, can you prepare the circuit-change request? I need a quick rollback plan.
Alex Chen: pushing config: ``config-router apply --customer AcmeCorp --set egress=us-west-2-aux --announce-static 10.12.0.0/16``
Alex Chen: applied. monitoring.
PagerDuty: Incident PD-83421 acknowledged by Priya Patel
Jordan Lee: watching metrics: control plane RTT to AcmeCorp drops from 1800ms to 420ms after route change. agent heartbeats recovering.
Maya (Customer Support): updated AcmeCorp support thread: "We're investigating a network issue impacting private deployment egress; we've routed your traffic through a temporary fallback. Please advise if you still see timeouts." customer replied: "latency improved, some requests still failing"
Alex Chen: follow up: restarted on-prem agent for AcmeCorp with rolling reboot command, agent reported `connected` within 45s. logs:
```
acme-agent.service: Start request repeated too quickly
acme-agent[1234]: reconnecting to control plane at 10.2.3.5: connected
``` 
Priya Patel: heartbeat metrics show steady 1/s now. still seeing occasional spikes on model-inference latency due to in-flight requests dropping earlier.
Jordan Lee: mitigation summary for postmortem: root cause likely ISP-level flapping between customer VGW and our transit edge causing BGP session instability -> blackholed egress -> on-prem agent lost heartbeat -> client timeouts. Temporary mitigation: re-route to aux-egress and restart on-prem agent. Next steps: coordinate with Customer Network team + AcmeCorp to check their VGW/ISP; consider automated fallback policy for sustained BGP flaps.
Alex Chen: I'm escalating to Network PM to schedule a deeper investigation. raising an incident ticket for RCA: INC-2026-83421
Priya Patel: handing off to Jordan for next shift. Jordan, please pick up monitoring and customer comms for the next 3 hours.
Jordan Lee: taking over. I'll post periodic updates every 30m and close PD when stable > 30m.
PagerDuty: Incident PD-83421 status: Resolved? No, still acknowledged. Recommendation: wait for 30m stable window.
Maya (Customer Support): customer confirms no new timeouts in last 10m, they will run longer synthetic for 1 hour. asked for update if anything changes.
Alex Chen: quick notes for post-incident: attach bgp logs, route change config diff, agent restart timestamps, customer ticket link. putting that in INC-2026-83421
Incident Bot: Reminder: please run the incident checklist and add severity, timeline, mitigations to the ticket
Priya Patel: checklist started. will add playbooks and draft postmortem with timeline. tagging @NetworkPM and @Platform-Reliability for RCA
Jordan Lee: leaving a handoff note: continuing monitoring from 1929999000 -> 1929999022, if flaps return revert route and escalate to carrier support. closing thread in 1h if no regressions. :white_check_mark:
Maya (Customer Support): note: update sent to AcmeCorp at 12:58 PDT, they appreciate the quick temporary fix. will keep them posted.
Alex Chen: thanks everyone. closing comms here once PD cleared and 30m stable.
